text:
### Mortgage-Specific Documents  
**Mortgages require extended retention due to security (property lien).**  
| Document Type | Retention Period |
|---|---|
| **Mortgage Application** | Life of loan + 6 years |
| **Underwriting File** | Life of loan + 6 years |
| **Property Valuation** | Life of loan + 6 years |
| **Legal Charge/Deed** | Life of loan + 6 years |
| **Payment Records** | Life of loan + 6 years |  
---

raw_entities.name: Data Retention Policy for Mortgage Documents
raw_entities.description: Policy governing the retention and lifecycle management of mortgage-related documents. Establishes extended retention periods for mortgage applications, underwriting files, property valuations, legal charges, and payment records due to the security interest (property lien) held by the bank.
context: Mortgages require extended retention due to security (property lien).
Life of loan + 6 years

raw_entities.name: Mortgage Application Document Retention Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to retain mortgage application documents for the life of the loan plus 6 years following loan termination or payoff.
context: Mortgage Application | Life of loan + 6 years

raw_entities.name: Underwriting File Document Retention Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to retain underwriting files for the life of the loan plus 6 years following loan termination or payoff.
context: Underwriting File | Life of loan + 6 years

raw_entities.name: Property Valuation Document Retention Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to retain property valuation documents for the life of the loan plus 6 years following loan termination or payoff.
context: Property Valuation | Life of loan + 6 years

raw_entities.name: Legal Charge and Deed Document Retention Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to retain legal charge documents and deeds for the life of the loan plus 6 years following loan termination or payoff, reflecting the bank's security interest in the property.
context: Legal Charge/Deed | Life of loan + 6 years

raw_entities.name: Mortgage Payment Records Retention Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to retain payment records for the life of the loan plus 6 years following loan termination or payoff.
context: Payment Records | Life of loan + 6 years

raw_entities.name: Property Lien Security Risk
raw_entities.description: The operational and legal risk arising from the bank's security interest (property lien) in mortgaged properties, necessitating extended document retention to evidence and protect the bank's claim.
context: Mortgages require extended retention due to security (property lien).

raw_entities.name: Mortgage Product
raw_entities.description: Secured lending product where the bank holds a legal charge over residential or commercial property as security. Subject to extended document retention requirements due to the nature of the security interest.
context: Mortgages require extended retention due to security (property lien).
Life of loan + 6 years
